name: Nurse's Escape - The Heart of the Problem
summary: Nurse's Escape - The Heart of the Problem is a VR game that simulates an escape room based on heart disease awareness. The purpose of this project is to develop Immersive Virtual Reality Escape Rooms focused on Heart Disease. Heart disease is the leading cause of death for men, women, and people of most racial and ethnic groups in the United States.
